newsitem.title: USA: Iowa-S Minn cattle market up $0.50 to $2.00 - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Iowa-S Minn cattle market up $0.50 to $2.00 - USDA.

text.p: Slaughter steers and heifers were $0.50 to $1.00 per cwt higher, compared with Tuesday's close, USDA said. Trade moderate to active. Demand moderate to firm. Seller interest moderate. Offerings current.
Steers - Select to mostly Choice 2-4 1200-1300 lbs 70.00-70.50.
Heifers - Select to mostly Choice 2-4 1075-1200 lbs 70.00-70.75 few 69.00.
On a carcass basis (weight only) compared Tuesday's close, slaughter steers and heifers were $1.00-$2.00 higher.
